skill_name: Suggest a practical solution to the water crisis.
workflow: A practical solution to the water crisis could include targeting water wastage and encouraging water conservation measures through public awareness campaigns. Governments could also launch initiatives to clean and purify polluted water sources, while also investing in innovative technologies to improve water management, such as desalination plants and rainwater storage systems. Additionally, water pricing policies can be implemented to incentivize efficient use, and taxation systems can be used
